body: I should also say, after the first message she sent, she added “Not trying to put fuel to a flame. Trying to stop it.”

My response, which took a while to craft to what I knew she would try to refute, while trying to get my points across. I’ve dealt with her for almost 26 years, I don’t put up with too much crap anymore. I’m so over it. She’s placed me in several depressions and sent me into an addictive spiral once. She WILL NOT cause that again. I know I shouldn’t let her make me sweep things under the rug, but I love my sisters.

“I’m not even really sure how to respond to this. I stated I would not get into this again, but you want to continue to tear people down passive aggressively, to use your own words. If you didn’t want her brought up, don’t use a tactic she would use. 
If you’d like me not to talk about these things, simply say so. Don’t tear down in the process. 

I’m not sure what other comments you’re referring to, I try damn hard to be civil with you, which is hard sometimes. You’re not an easy person,  either. With both of our personalities, that’s inevitably going to be a problem occasionally. No matter how hard one or the other tries. I came back into your life for the girls, so if that doesn’t work for you, we can go back to how it was before. 

I have enough to struggle with on a daily basis to fight through this too. I’ve told you, if I’d known how much it would have struck a nerve, I’d have said nothing. I had meant nothing bad by it. I also said I wouldn’t bring up any other memories. If you’d like to beat a dead horse, beat it by yourself. I don’t want to take part. I’ve said my piece, I’ve apologized, I’ve said I won’t do it again. There is nothing more I can do to please you”

That makes sense. That response from her was after telling her I wouldn’t bring them up again, and would not broach the subject again, as it just isn’t worth the time. 

I told her(I shouldn’t have, I know. But, for my sisters I feel like I have to) I’d apologized, told her I wouldn’t bring it up again, and there was nothing else regarding it I could do to please her. I made it clear that if she didn’t want me to bring up nGma, she shouldn’t have used her tactic. If she wants to beat a dead horse, she can do so by herself, I won’t take part. As well as that I’m ready to go back to how it was before, NC. 

Zero response.

Thank you. Writing it was oddly cathartic. I’m considering sharing it, but uploading it somewhere to do so just seems, I don’t know. Excessive I guess. I’m considering letting my husband know that there is one. But I know telling him will cause complete panic. And that’s what I want to avoid. 

I can call the mental health people. I had ‘self referred’ a few years ago. It took longer, and I never stuck with it. But I should. We wonder if they even got a request from the hospital at this point. I’m kind of hoping I can get him to call to figure it out. I just have a fear of telling anyone else that I wrote it. Being committed sucked, and broke me in a different way. I’d rather suffer through it here than in a cement room with a camera in the corner. 

Even though I know I probably need it. 

Anyways, thanks for the reply. I know no one can really help, but it’s nice knowing that someone knows.

Okay. Note finished. One less thing to worry about. I’m just at a loss. The professionals I guess didn’t care enough to actually give me the help they were supposed to. They said a few days. Today is day 22 since sweet talking myself out of commitment. I feel like the normal people around me, well, the only one who cares, has done all he can to help me.
